description: Normalize document body inputs, enforce translation validity, and align the document-evidence API contract across backend and frontend.

userStories.title: Add shared document body normalizer
userStories.description: As a backend maintainer, I want one shared normalizer for HTML and markdown document bodies so that downstream pipeline stages always receive body-only markdown.
acceptanceCriteria: HTML normalization strips scaffold tags and extracts article/main/body content into markdown-style text
Markdown normalization removes embedded HTML blocks while preserving headings and body text
userStories.notes: Validated on 2026-04-16: shared document normalization module and unit tests were already present on the current branch; targeted acceptance tests passed in the Ralph worktree.

userStories.title: Normalize acquired and parsed document bodies before storage
userStories.description: As a backend maintainer, I want web-acquired and parser-produced markdown normalized before storage so that downstream translation and extraction see one canonical document body format.
acceptanceCriteria: `FirecrawlService` normalizes fit_markdown or cleaned_html fallback content and marks metadata with `normalized_body` and `body_selector`
`DocumentParsingAgent` normalizes collected parser markdown before returning `markdown_content`
`process_web_page_task` stores normalized markdown and tags stored acquisition metadata with `normalized_body=true`

`uv run --directory apps/backend pytest -q tests/unit/test_firecrawl_service.py tests/unit/test_document_parsing_agent.py tests/unit/test_tasks.py::test_process_web_page_task_stores_normalized_markdown` passes
userStories.notes: Validated on 2026-04-16: normalization wiring in firecrawl, parser collection, and web-content storage was already landed on the current branch; targeted acceptance tests passed in the Ralph worktree.

userStories.title: Reject untranslated or non-English translation output
userStories.description: As a backend maintainer, I want translation skip and validation rules enforced so that untranslated or non-English outputs cannot silently pass into downstream extraction.
acceptanceCriteria: `task_manager` uses `should_skip_translation` for skip gating and raises `translation_validation_failed` when corrected output is empty, unchanged, or still non-English
Workflow and supervisor nodes only reuse an existing translation if it passes validation; invalid existing translations are cleared and retranslated
userStories.notes: Validated on 2026-04-16: translation validation module and the task_manager/workflow/supervisor enforcement hooks were already present on the current branch; targeted acceptance tests passed in the Ralph worktree.

userStories.title: Return a stable document evidence API contract
userStories.description: As a frontend and backend maintainer, I want `/evidence/document/{document_id}` to return a stable document-evidence payload so that consumers can rely on processed text and graph data without parsing generic blobs.
acceptanceCriteria: `GET /evidence/document/{document_id}` returns `document_id`, `source_text`, `translated_text`, `ps3_evidence`, and `graph` in a document-specific payload
The route loads `original_format.md`, `en_format.md`, and processed JSON from MinIO with empty-string or empty-object fallbacks when artifacts are missing
Existing graph search data remains available under the nested `graph` field
userStories.notes: Validated on 2026-04-16: the stable document-evidence payload and MinIO artifact loading were already present in `src/api/routes/evidence.py`; targeted integration tests passed in the Ralph worktree.

userStories.title: Align frontend document and export pages with the stable evidence payload
userStories.description: As a frontend maintainer, I want the document page and request export page to consume the stable document-evidence contract so that structured evidence and reading columns render without contract-warning fallbacks.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `DocumentEvidencePayload` and `DocumentEvidenceResponse` types and make `getEvidenceDocument` return the typed response
`normalizeEvidence` prefers `source_text` and `translated_text` from the stable payload before fallback parsing
`document-page.tsx` renders the structured evidence panel without the unstable-contract warning, and `request-export-page.tsx` renders reading columns from the same payload
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Validated on 2026-04-16: typed document-evidence API usage, stable payload normalization, focused Vitest coverage, and Playwright browser verification all passed in the Ralph worktree.

userStories.title: Run the final cross-stack verification slice
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want one final backend and frontend verification wave so that the document normalization, translation validation, and contract-alignment slice is proven before handoff.
acceptanceCriteria: `uv run --directory apps/backend pytest -q tests/unit/test_document_normalization.py tests/unit/test_firecrawl_service.py tests/unit/test_document_parsing_agent.py tests/unit/test_translation_validation.py tests/unit/test_tasks.py::test_process_web_page_task_stores_normalized_markdown tests/unit/test_tasks.py::test_run_node_translation_fails_when_output_is_still_non_english tests/test_supervisor_e2e.py::TestTranslationNode::test_translation_retranslates_invalid_existing_translation tests/integration/test_graph_api.py::test_get_document_evidence_returns_processed_text_and_graph tests/integration/test_graph_api.py::test_get_document_evidence_gracefully_handles_missing_artifacts` passes
userStories.notes: Validated on 2026-04-16: final backend slice passed (14 tests), frontend slice passed (7 tests), and frontend production build succeeded in the Ralph worktree.
